permissions.requiredSubtitle: Grant these Android permissions afore startin' the service.
permissions.allGranted: All required permissions be granted. Turn on the service to continue.
permissions.returnHint: After grantin' access in Android Settings, return here an' enable the service.
permissions.notificationExplanation: Android protects notification listener access behind special permission layers. Dependin' on yer phone brand, follow one o' the methods below.
permissions.methodA: Method A: Special App Access (Pixel, Motorola, Infinix, Stock)
permissions.methodAStep2: Go to Special App Access > Notification Access.
permissions.methodAStep3: Find Kruzty Dynamics an' switch on Allow notification access.
permissions.methodB: Method B: App Info > Ellipsis (Xiaomi/HyperOS, Samsung, Oppo)
permissions.methodBStep1: Open device Settings > Apps > Manage Apps / App List.
permissions.methodBStep3: Tap the three dots at the top-right corner.
permissions.methodBStep4: Tap Allow restricted settings / Special App Access > Grant.
permissions.notificationAccessDescription: Notification Access lets Kruzty Dynamics capture live media session playback events (Song Title, Artist, Album, an' Playback State) from Spotify, YouTube Music, an' media players.
permissions.usageDescription: Usage Access be required to spot which app or game ye be currently runnin' in the foreground, so Kruzty Dynamics can match it against yer configured Application Catalog.
permissions.batteryDescription: Modern Android systems put background processes to sleep after a few minutes. Exemptin' Kruzty Dynamics from battery optimization ensures continuous, uninterrupted Discord Rich Presence updates.
permissions.usageGuardDescription: Required to spot which app be currently in the foreground.
permissions.notificationGuardDescription: Required to spot media playback an' its metadata.
permissions.foregroundGuardDescription: Lets Android show the service notification while it runs.
permissions.serviceStartError: Couldn't start the Android presence service, arr.
permissions.foregroundDescription: Required by Android 13+ to display the ongoing foreground service notification in yer status bar, confirm' that the Discord presence engine be runnin'.
